units: Ḥull. 91ᵃ it is called gid hannasheh (v. גִּיד), שנ׳ ממקזמו וכ׳ because it slipped from its place and went up; Yalk. Gen. 133.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:6">Ib.</cite> <he>א״ר חנניא … שנשא את מקומו</he> R. Ḥ. said, … because it left its place; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:6">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> <he>שנשה ממקומו</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Nedarim 50b:9">Ned. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>אבותינו אמרו נָשִׁינוּ טובה וכ׳</he> our fathers said (<cite ref="Lamentations 3:17">Lam. III, 17</cite>), we have forgotten the good times: we have not even seen them &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102b:19">Snh. 102ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>מנ̇ש̇ה̇</he>) <he>שנ̇ש̇ה יה̇</he> he forgot Yah.
Pesik. R. s. 45 (ref. to נְשׂוּי, Ps. XXXII, 1) אל תהי … ש״ין נְשׁוּי read it not with Samekh (n’suy), but with Shin, n’shuy, whose sin is forgotten; a. e.

senses.gloss: (with ב, cmp. נְסַק Af.) [to raise, collect,] to have a claim against; to be a creditor of.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 75b:5">B. Mets. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>נוֹשֶׁה בחבירו מנה</he> he who has a claim &c., to whom his neighbor owes money.
<cite ref="Menachot 85b:18">Men. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>נושה בי וכ׳</he> I owe him &c.; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:7">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> (expl. <he>השיאני</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:13">Gen. III, 13</cite>) <he>הטעני</he> he led me astray; v. <cite ref="C01286"><he>גָּרָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to make a loan to; to collect, distrain; to pledge. Ib. (expl. השיאני) חייבני he made me a debtor (guilty, v. חוּב).
units: Cant. R. to II, 7 (ref. to אֶשָּׂא, Ps. XXV, 1) אַשִּׁיא כתיב it may be read ashshi, I pledge (my soul); שהיו מַשִּׁיאִין נפשם על וכ׳ they (the martyrs) pledged their lives for the sanctification &c. (v.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 25">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXV</cite> <he>שנתמשכנו וכ׳</he>); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 25">ib.</cite> <he>משיאין … מהם</he> they (the torturers) take their lives as pledges; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 667:3">Yalk. Ps. 667</cite> <he>משיחין</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: הִנְשִׁי to cause to forget. Snh. l. c. (play on מנ̇ש̇ה) שהנ̇ש̇י את ישראל לאביהם וכ׳ he made Israel forget their Father in heaven; Yalk. Kings 245 שהִנְשִׁיא.
